name: @swarmclawai/mcp-gateway
stderr:
Usage: mcp-gateway [options] [command]

Local MCP gateway: fans out to N downstream MCP servers, namespaces tools, and
lazy-loads schemas so your context window isn't eaten by MCP boilerplate.

Options:
  -V, --version                                    output the version number
  --json                                           emit machine-readable JSON on stdout
  --quiet                                          suppress stderr logs
  --verbose                                        print verbose logs on stderr
  --cwd <path>                                     override working directory for relative paths
  --config <path>                                  path to mcp-gateway.config.json
  -h, --help                                       display help for command

Commands:
  start [options]                                  start the gateway. Default: stdio for an upstream MCP client. Pass --http to expose a streamable-http endpoint at POST /mcp instead.
  status                                           print gateway configuration and connection status
  token-report                                     estimate tokens each downstream spends on tool schemas
  validate                                         validate mcp-gateway.config.json without connecting to any downstream
  add-server [options] <name> <command> [args...]  append a downstream server to the config file
  init [options]                                   create a starter mcp-gateway.config.json
  add [options] <agent>                            install mcp-gateway into an upstream agent's MCP config (claude-code, cursor, cline, windsurf, ...)
  help-agents                                      print machine-readable CLI catalog (for coding agents)
  help [command]                                   display help for command
